_comment: Copy this file to snippets.json and paste each vendor's default <script> snippet in headHtml. Keys are tool ids from manifest.json. Snippets are public in the browser but gitignored here to avoid accidental commits before you are ready.

plausible.setupNotes: Plausible Cloud → Add site bench.analyticsvs.com → copy <head> snippet

fathom.headHtml: <!-- Paste hosted Fathom script from dashboard -->
fathom.setupNotes: Fathom Analytics → Add site → copy tracking code

google-analytics-4.headHtml: <!-- Paste gtag.js snippet with your G-XXXXXXXX ID -->
google-analytics-4.setupNotes: GA4 Admin → Data streams → Web → copy gtag install

posthog.headHtml: <!-- Paste PostHog web snippet with project API key -->

matomo.setupNotes: Use Matomo Cloud (not self-hosted) for comparable CDN delivery

umami.headHtml: <!-- Paste Umami Cloud script with website ID -->
umami.setupNotes: Umami Cloud → Add website → tracking code

ahrefs.headHtml: <!-- Paste Ahrefs Web Analytics snippet after domain verification -->
ahrefs.setupNotes: Ahrefs Free → Web Analytics project → verify bench.analyticsvs.com
